gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 3.6's own commit) the Phase 3.7 rebuild was performed against, before Phase 3.7's own commit (which adds this manifest update) exists. Phase 3.7 adds no database migrations; it adds the Offline Test Center screen, a root-cause fix for a hardcoded dev-fixture translation id that silently broke Bible detection/search/presentation validation whenever only the real BSB dataset (never the KJV dev fixture) was installed, and a new full-chain acceptance test - see docs/phase-3-7-offline-operator-test.md for the exact diff.

provenance.note: This artifact supersedes the Phase 3.6 installer (previously SHA-256 e055d4a492d47bedbc6d75e089bc9cbb8a21e0a450102d0b6d8cdf862255171d) because this phase fixed 12 call sites in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs that hardcoded the Phase 1.2 dev-fixture translation id 'KJV' as a fallback whenever the frontend omitted translationId - including the live-microphone and manual-transcript detection pipelines themselves, not just Bible Library search/browse - added a new apps/desktop/src/components/testcenter/TestCenter.tsx 'Offline Test Center' screen, and added a new full-chain Phase 3.7 acceptance test (pipeline::tests::phase_3_7_full_offline_operator_chain_acceptance). releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.7 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Full Offline Operator Test Mode & System Verification). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-3-7-offline-operator-test.md for the full PASS/PARTIAL/NOT AVAILABLE/NOT VERIFIED breakdown and final gate.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine, including the target HP EliteBook laptop. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real human operator workflow has been exercised against this build. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation. Per this phase's own binding rule (spec section 41), the absence of Environment C evidence means the Phase 3.7 offline-operator gate itself is recorded as HOLD, not PASS, regardless of how complete the Environment A/B evidence is.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
